heading: Meetings of shareholders and voting

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF 76[A] LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS SPECIFIED SECURITIES 77[AND NON-CONVERTIBLE DEBT SECURITIES]

content:
44. (1) The listed entity shall provide the facility of remote e-voting facility to its
shareholders, in respect of all shareholders' resolutions.
(2) The e-voting facility to be provided to shareholders in terms of sub-regulation (1), shall be
provided in compliance with the conditions specified under the Companies (Management and
Administration) Rules, 2014, or amendments made thereto.
(3) The listed entity shall submit to the stock exchange, within 436[two working days] of
conclusion of its General Meeting, details regarding the voting results in the format
specified by the Board.
(4) The listed entity shall send proxy forms to holders of securities in all cases mentioning that
a holder may vote either for or against each resolution 437[:]
438[Provided that the requirement to send proxy forms shall not be applicable to general
meetings held only through electronic mode.]
439[(5) The top 100 listed entities by market capitalization 440[***] shall hold their annual
general meetings within a period of five months from the date of closing of the financial year.
(6) The top 100 listed entities shall provide one-way live webcast of the proceedings of the
annual general meetings.]
441 [***]

footnotes.text:
435 Substituted for “Voting by shareholders” by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
(Amendment) Regulations, 2018, w.e.f. 1.4.2019.

436 Substituted for “forty eight hours” by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Second
Amendment) Regulations, 2021 w.e.f. 5.5.2021.

437 Substituted for the symbol “.” by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and
Disclosure Requirements) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. 13.12.2024.

438 Inserted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
(Third Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. 13.12.2024.

439 Inserted by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Amendment) Regulations, 2018,
w.e.f. 1.4.2019.

440 The words “, determined as on March 31st of every financial year,” omitted by the Securities and Exchange
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f.
31.12.2024.

441 Omitted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
(Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. 31.12.2024. Prior to its omission, the Explanation read as follows:
“Explanation: The top 100 entities shall be determined on the basis of market capitalisation, as at the
end of the immediate previous financial year.”
